integrity: The proof is an exact case split on whether the universal center belongs to the set. Without the center, each clique blade contributes at most two vertices independently; with the center, at most one outer vertex is allowed. Maximality is then checked by one-vertex extensions. An independent exhaustive verifier tests the graph definition directly.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to generalized windmills K_1 join nK_m with n,m at least two.
The finite exhaustive check covers parameter pairs with at most eighteen vertices and is corroborative only.
The theorem does not cover multi-center generalized windmills or Dutch windmills with longer cycle blades.
Literature searches cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed exact formulas.
title: Dissociation polynomial and all maximal dissociation sets of generalized windmills
